request.prompt:
A Python function fails its tests.

Code:
```python
def solution(lst):
    return sum([x for idx, x in enumerate(lst) if idx%2==1 and x%2==1])
```

Test output:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "solution.py", line 28, in <module>
    check(solution)
    ~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^
  File "solution.py", line 18, in check
    assert solution([5, 8, 7, 1])    == 12
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
AssertionError
```

In at most three sentences, state the root cause of the bug. Do not write code.

response.text: The function mistakenly filters for elements at odd indices (`idx%2==1`) instead of even indices, so it sums the wrong positions. The test expects the sum of oddâindexed elements that are odd, but the example actually requires summing the values at even indices (5 + 7 = 12). Thus the index parity condition is inverted.
